agent_decisions_decided_iff_answered.name: agent_decisions_decided_iff_answered
agent_decisions_decided_iff_answered.value: ("agent_decisions"."owner_status" in ('approved', 'declined')) = ("agent_decisions"."decided_at" is not null and "agent_decisions"."decided_by" is not null)

products_lowest_price_matches_mode.name: products_lowest_price_matches_mode
products_lowest_price_matches_mode.value:
("products"."pricing_mode" = 'fixed' and "products"."lowest_price" is null)
        or ("products"."pricing_mode" = 'negotiable' and "products"."lowest_price" is not null and "products"."lowest_price" <= "products"."price")

customers_delivery_pin_complete.name: customers_delivery_pin_complete
customers_delivery_pin_complete.value: ("customers"."delivery_latitude" is null) = ("customers"."delivery_longitude" is null) and ("customers"."delivery_latitude" is null) = ("customers"."delivery_pin_at" is null)

far_quotes_priced.name: far_quotes_priced
far_quotes_priced.value: ("far_quotes"."status" = 'estimating') = ("far_quotes"."proposed_price" is null) and ("far_quotes"."proposed_price" is null) = ("far_quotes"."source" is null)

listing_drafts_prices_match_mode.name: listing_drafts_prices_match_mode
listing_drafts_prices_match_mode.value:
("listing_drafts"."pricing_mode" = 'fixed' and "listing_drafts"."lowest_price" is null)
        or ("listing_drafts"."pricing_mode" = 'negotiable' and ("listing_drafts"."lowest_price" is null) = ("listing_drafts"."price" is null))

orders_delivery_pin.name: orders_delivery_pin
orders_delivery_pin.value: ("orders"."delivery_latitude" is null) = ("orders"."delivery_longitude" is null) and ("orders"."delivery_type" = 'pickup') = ("orders"."delivery_latitude" is null and "orders"."delivery_zone" is null)
